name: I Can't Take This TV Head Off Unless I Confess to My Ghost Crush!
source:
In the LGBT visual novel, you play as Ethan, a human in a modern fantasy world. At a Halloween party, you discover that you can't take off your costume until you confess your feelings to your crush, Zax the Emo Ghost!

[From [url=https://banana-ooyu.itch.io/ghost-crush]itch.io[/url]]
